fallback_apk_manifest_parsing.description: The zip-level fallback parser successfully reads plain text AndroidManifest.xml files using regex when binary androguard parsing fails.

dex_bytecode_scan_indicators.description: Scans the decompressed classes.dex bytes inside the APK ZIP file to locate API keywords such as SmsManager, AccessibilityService, and window layout managers.

validation_gated_weight_calibration.description: Validation metrics are computed during parameter search and weights are rolled back to baseline if validation split F1-score degrades.

india_banking_clone_detection.description: Computes sequence matcher ratio and certificate matches against major Indian banks configured in official_banks.json.

xai_rationale_fallback_engine.description: Uses a local rule-based descriptor engine to generate explanation rationales when connection to external Vertex AI LLM APIs fails.

dynamic_sandbox_telemetry.evidence: None (all sandbox telemetry is mocked; no Android emulator or dynamic tracer is integrated)
dynamic_sandbox_telemetry.description: The execution and socket telemetries are mock structures and not driven by live device execution.

autonomous_evasive_bytecode_generation.evidence: backend/evader_agent.py (produces text recommendations only; no bytecode compilation)
autonomous_evasive_bytecode_generation.description: Suggests evasive strategies textually but does not write or compile Dalvik bytecode.

visual_screen_deception_checking.evidence: None (impersonation checks are text-based sequence ratio matchers on package name and app label)
visual_screen_deception_checking.description: Does not analyze screenshot layouts or perform pixel checks.

threat_graph_visual_engine.evidence: None (dashboard renders steps as a list)
threat_graph_visual_engine.description: No graphical node network library is integrated in the dashboard.
